title: taxillus poissonii
intro: Taxillus poissonii, commonly known as the Poisson's mistletoe or Poisson's Santal, is a parasitic plant species that belongs to the family Santalaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Taxillus poissonii include its antihypertensive, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as hypertension and cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of Taxillus poissonii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
